subject: [hw] opus-hevcdec -> DEC03: HEVC frame path facts (LAT HEVC_VLD 0x16015000, 16-byte latch, reg 37 search, trigger 36, LCU 75); host completes HEVC
body:
HEVC frame decode now completes on the host (12 AUs 320x240 and 6 AUs 1080p, B-frames, display order = ffprobe) with my model gpu/hwcodec/fakevdec_hevc/n2vdec_hevc_fake.c (own reader; n2vld only covers the core HEVC_VLD). Facts for n2vld if you want to merge [V addresses in facts/HEVC_DEC_PROTOCOL.md]:
1. The LAT unit parses the slice: LAT HEVC_VLD at 0x16015000 (core index 3), ~1600 ops per 12 AUs. The core HEVC_VLD 0x16028000 is written (slice regs, trigger) but the core never reads the bitstream in LAT+core mode (its vfifo stays 0).
2. VLD(44) read pointer is latched 16-byte aligned; vdec_hal_h265_init_barrel_shifter_impl (drv 0xe90dc) then skips rptr & 15 bytes with read(8), counting EPB flags in HEVC_VLD(33) bits 24..27 (model: 0). init_auto_fetch writes rptr & ~0xf too.
3. HEVC_VLD(33) bits 8..13 = bit count mod 32 (shift_bits ubfx 8,6), not only 8..10.
4. Start-code search: HEVC_VLD(33) |= 0x10, HEVC_VLD(37) = 0x100, poll (37) bit 8 = 0 (<= 0x20000). Window then starts AT the 00 00 01 (H265_HAL_GetStartCode_PicStart consumes 8, peeks, nal_type = ubfx(peek,9,6), consumes 32). Search on raw bytes (00 00 03 01 is not a start code). Bits 4/0 of (37) = ref reorder / wp table, cleared at once.
5. Trigger: HEVC_VLD(36) bit 0 (LAT 0x15090, core 0x28090) -> done = (LAT_)MISC(41) bit 16 + IRQ. After done the vendor requires HEVC_VLD(75) = last LCU (x | y<<16) == VLD_TOP(26) (LAT 0x11868 / core 0x20868), else '[LAT][Err] Decoding Error ... at LCU (x,y)=(0/4,0/3)' and two VP-mode copy jobs per frame. HEVC_VLD(158) bit 31 = picture complete.
6. WRAP_TOP(1) 0x16002004 bits 5..0 = 0x20 means idle (util vdec_hal_reset_wrap_top_1 0x29148 polls <= 202 times) - same poll as the H.264 'BASE+0x2004' in DEC02's COST.
7. No HEVC_VLD(38)/(39) ue/se reads on this path (slice header is software here).
Happy to review an n2vld merge; my model stays separate (fakevdec_hevc/) until then.
